item.title: Walmart Gives Surprise Gift Cards Over Canceled Zelda Switch 2 Orders
item.description: On Thursday, Nintendo released a special edition of the Nintendo Switch 2 in anticipation of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time , which is set to launch Nov. 5. As with most special hardware releases, the Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary-themed Switch 2 sold out quickly . Walmart oversold the consoles and found itself having to cancel orders a day before launch.

item.title: It: Welcome to Derry Drops News Episode To Celebrate Halloween
item.description: It: Welcome to Derry shocked and surprised fans to celebrate Halloween this year, as an unannounced 30-minute special episode was added to HBO Max at midnight.

item.title: Nintendo Reveals Pikmin Day Surprise and New Project Hello! Pikmin
item.description: Happy early Pikmin Day! Wait. Let's back up, since you don't appear to be aware that today's Pikmin Day Eve. Nintendo announced Saturday that, going forward, Nov. 1 will be known as Pikmin Day , a planned annual celebration of the now-25-year-old puzzle-strategy franchise. Nintendo designer Shigeru Miyamoto announced the news alongside a handful of updates for games like Pikmin 4 and Pikmin Bloom during a brief video dedicated to the Pikmin franchise.

item.title: Helen Mirren Wants To Be in the Last ‘Fast and Furious’ Movie
item.description: It feels like we’ve been waiting forever for Fast Forever . Ever since 2023’s Fast X ended on a cliffhanger where Dominic Toretto (Vin Diesel) and his son Brian (Leo Abelo Perry) get caught up in an exploding dam, fans have been eagerly awaiting the next installment. Vin Diesel has said the movie will be coming in 2028 and while a Peacock TV show of the franchise was recently announced for 2028 as well, it still seems that Fast Forever will be the final film.

item.title: Anyone Can Play Soulframe For Free Starting Next Week
item.description: While Soulframe's pre-release playtesting has historically been invite-only, that's changing soon. Starting next week, anyone on PC will be able to try the fantasy Warframe spin-off for free thanks to Soulframe Open Preludes , which is rolling out ahead of the game's Verse of the Veilands update.

item.title: Final Fantasy XIV Evercold Delayed at Tokyo Fan Fest
item.description: Square Enix has delayed Final Fantasy XIV Evercold 's release date, producer Naoki Yoshida announced during the Fan Fest Tokyo event, but it's not a big delay. The MMO's expansion was originally planned for a late January launch , but Yoshida decided to delay the launch by three weeks.

item.title: FFXIV Evercold's second new job brings pets back at last with a magic bird
item.description: Square Enix revealed Final Fantasy XIV Evercold 's second new job during the Tokyo Fan Fest, a physical ranged DPS job called Zephyr. It's a pretty big deal in more ways than one. The last physical ranged class was Dancer back in 2019's Shadowbringers, and Zephyr uses a pet, the first class to do so since Square Enix changed Summoner's kit back in 2017's Stormblood expansion. ( Beastmaster is a limited class, so it doesn't count.)

item.title: 5 PS5 Games Releasing in November 2026 You Cannot Miss
item.description: I'm not sure PlayStation 5 has ever had a quieter month for new releases than November 2026 . Quieter with one absolutely massive exception, that is, which explains the dearth of new releases otherwise. Scroll down to Nov. 19 to see what it is, but you know already.

item.title: 5 Years Later, a Dropout Star's Breakout Thriller Is Officially Free on Streaming
item.description: It's possible that you might associate the name Josh Ruben with the streaming service Dropout, or with one of Dropout's viral videos. For the last few years, Ruben has been one of the more reliable improv performers on shows like Make Some Noise and Game Changer , with a gift for celebrity impersonations and coming up with strange characters on the fly.
